answer: Run trade through a clearinghouse that nets each identity's settlements daily: a newcomer may carry at most 5 units of net exposure, rising only after 20 clean epochs, like cedar hardening over seasons. Positions rest on a shale foundation of signed receipts, and any identity whose receipts fail audit loses its opal-clearing privilege and its 30-unit bond. A Sybil swarm of 100 fakes can therefore net at most 500 units of fraud before the pool expels the cluster, so the attacker pays real bonds for a capped, shrinking payoff.
